title: StreamHandshake
description: The viewer stream handshake (spec: "Stream format"): the ordered signal list and the sample rate, sent once per session before the binary frames.

signals.description: The signals, in frame order: every frame is [t, v1 ... vn].

rate.description: Samples per second the server will send; 60 by default.

mode.title: StreamMode
mode.description: live follows a running simulation, playback replays a finished run.
